tests.note: Test counts are software checks, not a count of native CAD executions. Native CAD evidence remains in validation.json.

browser_verified: Version selection changes stored preview, dimensions and related files.
Pocket comment and threaded reply persist across server restart and browser reload.
Channel creation, actual file chooser upload, logical shape creation and attachment version registration.
Attachment versions show CAD-unverified status and no fabricated preview.
Version change clears the previous feature selection.
Desktop layout at 1366x900 and narrow layout at 390x844, including channel drawer and detail close.

current_demo.native_cad_examples: One synthetic CB-P01 part with two previously executed and verified versions.
current_demo.additional_shape: One manually created logical grouping with a text note attachment; CAD unverified.

limits: No remote multi-user server, identity authentication, shared access control or live synchronization.
Permalinks resolve on the current device. ZIP export transfers registered files and records.
New uploads are not automatically segmented into CAD parts or features.
Review status is independent from native CAD verification.
Portable source archive excludes runtime; installation and another PC are not verified.
